bio: Kulbhushan Narang is a Mortgage Agent Level 2 with Orbis Mortgage Group in Vaughan, Ontario. His site says he has been licensed since 2017 and worked as a mortgage specialist since 2008, with access to over 40 lenders. Services cover pre-approval, purchase, rental investment, refinance, construction, land, commercial, private/alternative lending and cross-border mortgages for foreign nationals and Canadians. Appointments run Mon-Fri 9-5 plus evenings and weekends by appointment.
